thread:
maria: Heads-up — saw a weird KV cache corruption during a long-context run on the MI250 lab rig. Pages are being reused but the page table shows overlapping PTEs for different slot ranges. Repro pretty reliably after ~120k tokens.

maria: Minimal log snippet: 
```
[2026-03-14T09:12:03Z] kvcache: alloc page id=0x7f4a size=64KB slot_base=0x1c000
[2026-03-14T09:12:03Z] kvcache: map pte(0x7f4a) -> phys(0x3f200) owner=gpu1
[2026-03-14T09:12:15Z] kvcache: alloc page id=0x7f4a size=64KB slot_base=0x5a000   # same id reused
[2026-03-14T09:12:15Z] kvcache: map pte(0x7f4a) -> phys(0x4c100) owner=gpu0   # overwrote mapping
```

maria: App-visible symptom: sudden token-level perplexity spikes and KV lookups returning stale kv slices.

aj: Curious — does the allocator reuse page ids but forget to invalidate a cross-gpu shadow entry? Could be a sentinel/tag wrap.

maria: That's my hunch. Repro works when we enable cross-GPU migration in the conﬁg (nvlink offload + software migration path). On single-GPU runs it's rare.

dylan: Can you dump the page-table stamps and the slotmap at the time of repro? I want to check stamp lifetime and if we have concurrent remap without fence.

maria: Pasted a diff view of the slotmap + stamps here: 
```
slotmap[0x1c000] = {page=0x7f4a, stamp=0xFFFFFFFFE1, owner=gpu1}
slotmap[0x5a000] = {page=0x7f4a, stamp=0x10, owner=gpu0}
```

maria: Notice the stamp wrap from 0xE1 -> 0x10, but we still had a stale shadow entry on gpu1.

perf-bot: New perf run uploaded: https://perf.internal/runs/480123/kv-migr-repro — flamegraph and timeline attached. Hot path shows heavy time in kvcache::remap_async and kernel selection stalls at 7s.

dylan: Thanks. From the flamegraph it looks like remap_async issues align with a high concurrency window where we initiate migration but allow reuse immediately. We probably need one of: a) stronger transfer fence, b) bump stamp width, or c) prevent immediate id reuse.

aj: Bumping stamp width helps but is only papering over the root cause — the free-list returns ids before all shadow mappings are cleared on peer GPUs. We need an explicit invalidation step or an epoch-based grace window.

tess: I can run a controlled experiment on MI250 (our AMD lab) to toggle peer-to-peer migration paths and force busy-wait retire of shadow entries. Which branch do you want me to test?

maria: Try the smear/disable-reuse branch I pushed: 
```
git checkout fix/kv-slow-reuse
bazel test //eng/runtime/kvcache:smoke --run_under=//tools/tracewrap
```

maria: That branch makes reuse sleep 50ms and issues explicit invalidation RPC to peers before reassigning id. Repro rate dropped from ~90% -> ~5% in 3 runs.

raj: For long-term solution we should avoid sleeps. Propose: add per-page epoch counters and make peer invalidation wait on epoch advancement, not time. Also add an assertion in debug builds to detect reused ids with active shadow refs.

dylan: Agreed. Also check kernel selection path: if we fall back to tiled kernels during migration we hold the KV mapping longer (we saw the remap stall coincide with selecting different tiled kernel). Could be amplification.

aj: Another datapoint: on H100 the repro is much less frequent, but we've seen subtle metadata fragmentation after long contexts — small holes accumulate and cause the free-list coalescer to produce adjacent reuse patterns that increase PTE collisions. Might be allocator geometry dependent (64KB vs 128KB slabs).

tess: Running MI250 lab experiments now. Will report slots/gc distribution and retention histograms. If we can reproduce the collision with an instrumented free-list we can add a fast path to tag a page with a unique epoch that peers check.

perf-bot: Upload note: instrumentation increased runtime +22% for the repro job; traces at https://perf.internal/runs/480123/kv-instrument. Use the 'slow' tag.

maria: For immediate mitigation on Hosted: I disabled cross-gpu migration for dedicated metal pool yesterday night for customers with long-context workloads. Monitoring shows no user-facing spikes. We should prepare a conﬁg patch to make that toggle available per-customer.

raj: Agreed — but we need a clear rollback plan when customers need the throughput. Can we support graceful degrade: migrate only warm pages, keep cold pages pinned?

dylan: Implementation notes: add an invalidation RPC to kvcache that marks shadow entries invalid and returns after ack. Peer acknowledges when local shadow map has cleared references. Then safe to reuse id. Also add debug-only crash on reuse-with-active-shadow to catch regressions in CI.

maria: I'll open a PR with the epoch + invalidation handshake + debug assert. Assigning reviewers: @dylan @aj. Will include microbench numbers.

tess: If PR lands, I'll validate on MI250 + H100 matrix and run long-context 500k token stress test.

aj: One more ask: add telemetry counters for "reused_before_invalidate" and "invalidation_latency" so we can track risk across fleets.

srebot: Noted — creating incident channel and alert for sudden token perplexity spike signatures for impacted pools. Incident: INC-2026-0314-1.

maria: Thanks all. Next steps: PR today, perf runs tomorrow, toggle for hosted gated behind config flag. I'll paste the PR link when ready. :thumbsup:
